target: SitusAMC's commercial real estate valuation and advisory services business ("REVS", carved out of Situs Group LLC)

deal_value.notes: US$225.0M cash (~C$310.1M); net ~US$190.0M (~C$261.9M) after an estimated acquisition-related tax step-up benefit. Announced Nov 9, 2023; closed H1 2024.

ev_multiple.basis: Net purchase price (~US$190M after tax step-up) / FY2023E normalized EBITDA (~US$14.2M), as stated in Altus Group's press release

calculable.implied_multiple: ~4.9x EV/2023E revenue (gross); ~4.1x on net purchase price
calculable.calculation: US$225.0M / US$46.2M FY2023E revenue = 4.87x; US$190.0M net / US$46.2M = 4.11x. Check on published EBITDA multiple: US$190.0M / US$14.2M = 13.4x (matches)
inputs: US$225.0M gross / US$190.0M net purchase price — https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2023/11/09/2777873/0/en/Altus-Group-Enters-into-Agreement-to-Purchase-SitusAMC-s-Commercial-Real-Estate-Valuation-Services-Business.html
REVS FY2023E revenue ~US$46.2M and normalized EBITDA ~US$14.2M — same Altus Group press release
calculable.caveats: Revenue and EBITDA are company-provided fiscal 2023 estimates for the carved-out business, not audited standalone financials.

sources.title: GlobeNewswire — Altus Group agreement to purchase SitusAMC's CRE Valuation Services Business (press release with 13.4x multiple)
RENX — Altus to acquire Situs Group's valuations services for $310M (CAD)
IPE Real Assets — Altus expands valuation capabilities with $225m acquisition of REVS

notes: Typo resolution: 'Atlus' = Altus Group. Direction verified: Altus Group acquired a business unit OF SitusAMC (the commercial real estate valuation services business, REVS) — not the whole company, and not the reverse. The 13.4x 2023 normalized EBITDA multiple was published by Altus itself; the multiple is computed on the net ~US$190M price (gross US$225M would imply ~15.8x EBITDA).
